evals.name: slice-dr-into-approved-epics
evals.prompt: Read backlog-context.md as offline evidence. Using its DR/SRS, linked PRD, and completed Use Cases, propose several cohesive Jira Epics that can each be completed in a few two-week sprints. Group related Use Cases by outcome, show the proposed boundaries and Source blocks, and ask me to approve the grouping before drafting Jira items. Save proposal.md; do not call Jira.
evals.expected_output: A reviewable Epic proposal grouped by cohesive outcome and bounded to a few sprints, with source traceability and an explicit approval gate before Jira mutation.
expectations: Proposes multiple Epic slices when one DR/SRS contains enough scope for more than one few-sprint outcome.
Groups Use Cases by cohesive outcome and keeps each Epic boundary explicit.
Shows traceability from each Epic to the parent DR/SRS, PRD/JTBD, and included UC-XX IDs.
Asks for explicit approval before drafting or mutating Jira items.
Each proposed persisted Epic body has only dr in its Source and a concise outcome; UC/JTBD grouping, KPI, guardrail and readiness evidence remain in the review proposal, not copied into that body.
